how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-loch-modan-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6387:obj:0: Bring ⟦E1⟧ to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:6387:details:0: I see a lot of young dwarves at my door, eager to learn the trade of mining. And if there's one thing a miner needs more than anything, it's a pick!

rows.quest:6387:completion:0: You have to get this to ⟦E2⟧, eh? For a small fee I can put you on the back of one of my gryphons, and it'll take you there. How does that sound?
rows.quest:6388:details:0: Here are the honorary picks for Brock's students. If you've already been to Thelsamar, then you should fly a gryphon back there!

rows.quest:6391:obj:0: Buy a gryphon to ⟦E2⟧ from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring ⟦E1⟧ to Golnir Bouldertoe in ⟦E2⟧.

rows.quest:6391:details:1: Speak to me again when you're ready for the journey.
rows.quest:6391:progress:0: What can I do for you, sir?
rows.quest:6391:completion:0: Ah, the lastest list of Brock's best pupils. I have a batch of honorary picks ready to go. I just need to chisel in the names of the students...
rows.quest:6392:obj:0: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master ⟦E4⟧, then bring the ⟦E3⟧ to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.

rows.quest:6392:details:2: Speak with me when you're ready to go.

rows.quest:6392:completion:1: Thank you for your help, ⟦2⟧. I am in your debt, but I hope this money will at least cover your travel costs.

rows.quest:416:progress:0: Hail, ⟦3⟧. How goes the rat catching?
rows.quest:416:completion:0: Ugh! When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!
rows.quest:418:obj:0: Bring 3 pieces of ⟦E7⟧, 3 ⟦E8⟧, and 3 ⟦E9⟧ to Vidra Hearthstove in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:418:details:0: There's never a shortage of empty bellies here in Thelsamar, kids running in and out, workers from the excavation coming in after a hard day's work. We're famous for our blood sausages, I don't suppose you've ever tried them?

rows.quest:418:completion:1: Oh, I've never known someone to take much interest in the making of sausages, but I'll give you the recipe just in case. Here you go, mind you eat them fresh!
rows.quest:224:obj:0: Mountaineer Cobbleflint of the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts.

rows.quest:267:obj:0: Bring 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.

rows.quest:237:obj:0: Mountaineer Gravelgaw in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers and report back to him.
rows.quest:237:details:0: Mountaineer Cobbleflint had nothing but good things to say about you, ⟦15⟧. For that reason I am going to entrust upon you a mission of utmost importance. We need to keep pressure on the invading Trogg forces until our Dwarven brethren return from the ⟦E11⟧ front.

rows.quest:237:progress:0: We need more time, ⟦16⟧. Your orders are to kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers. Keep the ⟦E16⟧ under pressure until we are granted reinforcements. This is no time for idle behavior.
rows.quest:237:completion:0: You accomplished your mission well, ⟦17⟧. The King himself would be proud.
rows.quest:237:completion:1: The reinforcements promised to us never showed, however. Apparently the ⟦E11⟧ front is a sea of crimson from the blood of our fallen brethren. The news of the losses leaves a bitter taste in one's mouth. But we must not let their deaths go for naught. We must rally in these grim times and bring glory back to the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:237:completion:2: Speak with Mountaineer Wallbang for reassignment. You're needed now more than ever.
rows.quest:263:obj:0: Mountaineer Wallbang in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter ⟦E17⟧ and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.
rows.quest:263:details:0: The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, ⟦18⟧. We need a ⟦19⟧ like you around here. The Trogg problem isn't getting any better. rows.quest:263:progress:0: ⟦E18⟧ so soon? In case I didn't make myself clear we need you to kill 10 Stonesplinter ⟦E17⟧ and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers, ⟦21⟧. Now go get 'em, Trogg-Slayer!
rows.quest:263:completion:0: I knew the second I laid eyes on you, ⟦22⟧, that you would make ⟦E2⟧ proud. You have served King Magni well. Now that you've proven yourself to be such a loyal aid to the Kingdom, perhaps you should talk with the Captain to see if he'll entrust you with a higher detail.
rows.quest:273:details:0: It's not too late though, you're welcome to go look for Huldar. He can't have made it very far, strong as they are, Miran and Saean can only move so fast laden down with those barrels.
rows.quest:273:details:1: They're taking the normal route to the site, leaving south out of town and following the curve of the Loch.
rows.quest:273:details:2: Shouldn't have a problem finding them unless they've already gotten there.
rows.quest:273:completion:0: Hmph, it'll take more than a Dark Iron ambush to stop the deliveries!
rows.quest:273:completion:1: But Saean... I would never have suspected him to be one of their sympathizers. We've been working with him for almost a year now... maybe I missed the signs.
rows.quest:298:obj:0: Bring ⟦E19⟧ to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:298:details:0: I need a progress report sent to Thelsamar - a progress report, and a restatement of my request for more blastpowder! Here's the report. Take it to Jern Hornhelm. He's our local contact in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:298:details:1: It's not a difficult task, but it must be done.
rows.quest:298:progress:0: Oh, a progress report from the site? Very good!

rows.quest:298:completion:1: Well, either way it's powder well spent!
rows.quest:298:completion:2: But what's strange is, I sent him plenty of blastpowder weeks ago. I wonder where it went...
rows.quest:301:details:0: We'll need approval to get ⟦E20⟧ more blastpowder. You'll have to take his report to the Explorers' League headquarters in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:301:details:1: Here's the report. Give it to Prospector Stormpike, and don't forget to duck after you deliver it. Stormpike is hotheaded, and he won't be happy to hear of ⟦E20⟧'s slow progress at the site.
rows.quest:301:details:2: You'll find Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers.
rows.quest:301:progress:0: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, ⟦24⟧. I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
rows.quest:301:completion:0: ⟦E21⟧ that ⟦E20⟧! I sent him a load of blastpowder weeks ago, but he's made no mention of it in this report.
rows.quest:302:obj:0: Speak with Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:302:details:0: If ⟦E20⟧ still needs blastpowder, then by Magni he'll have it! I sent the approval on ahead with a messenger to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar. He'll prepare the powder and other supplies to take to ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:302:details:1: And one more thing: I want you to personally see that the shipment of powder reaches its destination. The last one didn't, so keep your mind sharp and your eyes open.

rows.quest:307:obj:0: Go to the Silver Stream Mine and collect 4 loads of ⟦E22⟧.
rows.quest:307:details:0: The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago. It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!
rows.quest:307:details:1: We'll ⟦E23⟧ out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things. It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.
rows.quest:307:details:2: The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine. Good luck.
rows.quest:307:completion:0: Did you see a lot of Kobolds in there? I can't wait for the order to clear them out of the mine. The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
rows.quest:309:obj:0: Ensure Miran and the shipment arrive at the excavation site, then inform Prospector ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:309:details:1: First, we need to get this powder to ⟦E20⟧. It'll be a lot for me to carry, and these parts can get dangerous -- and who knows what else the Dark Irons might have in store for me.
rows.quest:309:details:2: I'll feel a lot better with you coming along.
rows.quest:309:progress:0: Where is my powder, ⟦27⟧? My need grows more desperate every day.
rows.quest:309:completion:0: Oh, thank the Light the powder is here. But it is troubling news that you bring as well. To think that the Dark Irons have sympathizers able to procure this sort of material for their dastardly plans.
rows.quest:309:completion:1: That's a matter for someone else to consider, some other time. I must put this powder to good use.
rows.quest:385:obj:0: Get 5 pieces of ⟦E24⟧ and 6 Crocolisk Skins for Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge.
rows.quest:385:details:0: Many a hunter is attracted to ⟦E6⟧ to hunt our famous crocs. There are always merchants who seek out crocolisk skins for clothing items or ⟦E25⟧, and there are also some who enjoy the taste of their meat.

rows.quest:385:progress:0: Did I tell you about the time I almost lost my hand to one of the crocs? Nasty bugger it was, teeth like knives. But I was lucky... Jammed the brute's jaw shut with my knife. Still have the knife around here somewhere...
rows.quest:385:completion:0: Well now, these are excellent specimens you collected, ⟦28⟧. Good money for high quality materials, that's for sure.
rows.quest:454:details:0: We'd been hauling the barrels of powder back and forth in trips before this... business. Now we have to split up the work, Miran's taking the barrels and I'm watching over the other ones.
rows.quest:454:details:1: I don't feel safe letting Miran haul the rest of the shipment by himself. When he's ready to go, maybe you could escort him on his next trip?
rows.quest:454:completion:1: You'll be escorting me to the excavation site? That's good to hear... After Saean and his cronies, who knows what else the Dark Irons might have up their sleeves?
rows.quest:454:completion:2: Anyways, let me just make some final checks. Talk to me again when you're ready to go.

rows.quest:1339:details:1: If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.

rows.quest:2038:details:0: As if crashing into the Loch wasn't bad enough, troggs from the ⟦E31⟧ island attacked me and stole my tools and special Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives. With no gyrocopter and no explosives, the movement has no ⟦E26⟧!

rows.quest:2038:completion:0: You've done the movement a great service, ⟦33⟧. The troggs and leper gnomes infesting Gnomeregan will soon feel the brunt of a gnomish air assault!
rows.quest:257:obj:0: Kill 6 Mountain Buzzards and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 15 minutes.
rows.quest:257:details:0: Think you can match wits with Daryl the Bold, huh? I should think not! Of course, you're more than welcome to try. Here's a challenge that should prove to be above your abilities, so don't feel too bad if you can't face up to it.

rows.quest:217:obj:0: Kill the Trogg leader, Grawmug, and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler then report back to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.

rows.quest:217:details:1: If you feel yourself worthy, ⟦39⟧, I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug and his two thugs. With the Trogg leadership dead, we just might stand a ⟦E26⟧ at pushing these beasts back into the ground.
rows.quest:217:progress:0: Grawmug and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler, are still alive. Your mission is not complete until all 3 have been brought to death. The Dwarven empire is counting on you, ⟦40⟧.
rows.quest:217:completion:0: Most excellent, ⟦41⟧! You have brought hope to ⟦E6⟧. With Grawmug dead, we stand a better ⟦E26⟧ of seeing the Troggs eliminated from the land.
rows.quest:258:obj:0: Kill 5 Elder Mountain Boars and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 12 minutes.
rows.quest:258:details:0: ⟦42⟧ath, is it? I can tell you're bursting with pride over completing the first test, hm? As I told you before, it's no large feat.
rows.quest:258:details:1: You should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them. I'll give you just twelve minutes this time.
rows.quest:258:details:2: Don't feel bad if you fail. I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!
rows.quest:258:details:3: Have I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? No? It was two years ago...
rows.quest:258:progress:0: It's only natural to feel sorry for yourself when shown up by someone so new to this world. You shouldn't feel bad, ⟦43⟧.⟦44⟧⟦45⟧Hm? Did I get your name wrong?
rows.quest:258:completion:0: You seem a bit worse for wear. No doubt the boars gave you some trouble, hm? No worries, I will be discreet about your struggle, I can imagine how hard it must be for you without the accusations of wagging tongues.
rows.quest:258:completion:1: Oh! You managed to kill the boars? I... well, that is... that is to say, I'm not surprised! Any child could have--bet?

rows.quest:161:obj:0: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to take the strange smelling powder to Ashlan Stonesmirk, the explosives expert in Dun Modr.

rows.quest:274:obj:0: Ashlan Stonesmirk wants you to return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and inform him of the new discovery.
rows.quest:274:details:0: This ain't no ordinary blast powder. Look at the tiny silver crystals. And the distinct smell! Why it's clear as daylight that this is Seaforium Powder. Seaforium is harmless enough. But once it's wet it could blow ⟦E2⟧ out of the mountain.
rows.quest:274:details:1: The chemical reaction can be defused by mixing four components: lurker venom, crushed Mo'Grosh crystal, a crocolisk tear and this disarming colloid. Now tell Hinderweir before it's too late!
rows.quest:274:progress:0: What is that you bring from Ashlan?
rows.quest:274:completion:0: A disarming colloid? For Seaforium? Oh heavens!
